# Capable_Agent_Knowledge

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The minimal set of information or structural priors that an agent must possess to achieve robust decision-making across a class of environments, as characterized by selection theorems. Guides the design of efficient neuromorphic topologies that encode only essential knowledge, reducing memory and energy overhead.
